data.long_meaning: The name Alpesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Alp', which means friend or protector. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities as a symbol of their role as a guardian and companion. Parents who choose Alpesh usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
